thread:
lena: quick postmortem follow-up on the partial responses/timeouts incident from earlier. compiling owners + timelines. TL;DR: three buckets — client reconnect/backoff, server-side stream handling (kv cache/backpressure), and observability/detection. please ack and claim.
jasper: taking the client reconnect/backoff work. plan: add jittered exponential backoff, cap in-flight reconnects per connection, and add client-side prefix cache invalidation. target: PR by Fri 2026-03-26. @lena can you add any coord constraints? :+1:
devon: i'll investigate server-side patchpoints — suspect KV cache invalidation race + long-tail blocking on async flush. will capture root-cause hypothesis and quick mitigations (fix locking, add short-circuit on malformed frame). aim to have a patch proposal + perf regression test by Tue 2026-03-23.
rika: observability and alerts here. proposal:
- new metric: streaming.partial_response_rate per model-route
- SLI: partial_response_rate > 0.15% over 5m -> P1 alert
- dashboard: token-level tail latency 95/99/999
will add Grafana panels and an alerting sigrok, timeline: Weds 2026-03-24.
sam (prod): i'll own rollout coordination. Suggest canary to 5% of traffic for the server-side fix, with automatic rollback on spike in partial_response_rate or 99th latency. Also will schedule a 1hr release window next week.
ops-bot: created INC-4321 for client/backoff work, INC-4322 for server fix, INC-4323 for observability. linking.
lena: notes on recurring pattern — this matches behavior in the Jan 2026 incident where heartbeat misses + load bursts produced similar partials. action: add a recurring postmortem digest to the runbook to capture pattern analysis every 30 days.
jasper: quick config suggestion for clients (will publish as RFC):
```
reconnect:
  max_attempts: 6
  base_backoff_ms: 150
  max_backoff_ms: 5000
  jitter: full
  max_inflight_reconnects: 2
  reconnect_window_s: 30
```
please review — i want this in SDKs + docs.
devon: testing notes — i'll add a stress test that simulates KV cache mismatch and sudden 1000x ephemeral connection churn. need infra help to seed the condition. @sam can you free a canary pool?
sam (prod): yes, i can schedule a canary pool Tue/Weds next week. will DM about exact slot. also add a runbook step: if partial_response_rate spikes > 0.5% during rollout -> immediate rollback and page oncall.
rika: adding an automated regression check: nightly run of a prompt suite to validate partial deliverability and continuity. will post the dashboard link here when ready.
lena: owners summary and deadlines:
- Jasper: client reconnect/backoff RFC + SDK PR — due 2026-03-26 (INC-4321)
- Devon: server-side fix proposal + tests — due 2026-03-23 (INC-4322)
- Rika: dashboards + alerts + nightly regression checks — due 2026-03-24 (INC-4323)
- Sam: canary scheduling + rollout playbook — due 2026-03-24
if anyone needs to swap ownership, tag me. we'll do a 30-min sync Thu 2026-03-25 10:00am PT and re-check status.
jasper: acked, will add PR link when opened.
devon: ack, starting triage now. i'll link the hypothesis doc here in thread by EOD.
rika: acked, i'll create the alert runbook snippet.
sam (prod): ack, scheduling canary and adding rollback rules.
lena: final ask — when you open PRs/tickets, include a short test plan (what to assert for partials/timeouts) and add smoke test steps for on-call to run. thanks everyone.
ops-bot: INC-4321 (reconnect-backoff) created by lena. INC-4322 (server-stream-fix) created by devon. INC-4323 (streaming-observability) created by rika. Links: https://tracker/redwood/INC-4321, https://tracker/redwood/INC-4322, https://tracker/redwood/INC-4323
jasper: PR opened https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2789 — basic reconnect RFC + client impl. added unit + integration tests.
devon: hypothesis doc: https://docs.redwood/notes/stream-partial-rootcause. starting server-side patch branch now.
rika: dashboards pushed to staging, alert rules in alert-manager pending review.
lena: great progress. we'll reconvene Thu 10:00am PT. tagging followup owners: @jasper @devon @rika @sam (prod).
